"""
Summary: 
Reads DXT1 compressed image data and decodes it into an Image structure.

Parameters: 
image (Image *): Pointer to the Image structure where the decoded pixels will be stored.
dds_info (DDSInfo *): Pointer to DDSInfo structure containing image dimensions and metadata.
exception (ExceptionInfo *): Pointer to ExceptionInfo structure for error handling.

Returns: 
MagickBooleanType: Returns MagickTrue on success or MagickFalse on failure.

Logic: 
The function processes the image in 4x4 pixel blocks, reading the necessary data from the input image blob. It calculates the colors based on the DXT1 compression format and sets the pixel values in the output image. If the image has an alpha channel, it ensures the matte property is correctly set. Finally, it synchronizes the pixel data and handles mipmap skipping.
